PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ../../.venv/bin/python -c 'import csv, datetime as dt, importlib.metadata as md; from pathlib import Path; rows=list(csv.DictReader(Path("opsd_de_load.csv").open())); times=[dt.datetime.fromisoformat(r["utc_timestamp"].replace("Z", "+00:00")) for r in rows]; values=[float(r["DE_load_actual_entsoe_transparency"]) for r in rows]; import math; print({"rows":len(rows), "first":str(times[0]), "last":str(times[-1]), "hourly_contiguous":all(b-a==dt.timedelta(hours=1) for a,b in zip(times,times[1:])), "finite_positive":all(math.isfinite(x) and x>0 for x in values)}); print({"train":sum(t.isoformat()[:10]<="2019-09-30" for t in times), "validation":sum("2019-10-01"<=t.isoformat()[:10]<="2019-12-31" for t in times), "test":sum("2020-01-01"<=t.isoformat()[:10]<="2020-01-07" for t in times)}); print({name:md.version(name) for name in ["pandas", "numpy", "matplotlib", "statsmodels", "pmdarima", "darts", "lightgbm", "holidays", "torch", "prophet"]})'
